source_text: Si filii, et heredes: heredes quidem Dei, coheredes autem Christi. Expectatio creaturae revelationem filiorum Dei expectat. Gloria Spiritui. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: If children, then also heirs: heirs indeed of God, but co-heirs of Christ. The expectation of the creation awaits the revelation of the sons of God. Glory to the Spirit. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[If children, then heirs — heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ >> Bible:Romans 8:17]]. [[Creation waits with eager longing for the revealing of the sons of God >> Bible:Romans 8:19]]. Glory to the Spirit. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
